AI-Augmented Data Analyst
About the role
As an AI-Augmented Data Analyst , you will make an impact by transforming complex data into actionable insights that support better decision-making across underwriting, claims, finance, and operational functions. You will be a valued member of the Data & Analytics team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, data engineers, and technology partners to deliver advanced analytics solutions that improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experiences.
This role combines traditional analytics expertise with emerging AI-assisted analytical techniques to accelerate insight generation while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy, governance, and data quality.
In this role, you will:
+ Develop and optimize analytical solutions using Snowflake SQL and modern data analysis tools to support enterprise reporting and decision-making.
+ Perform exploratory data analysis on large structured and semi-structured datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers.
+ Build and maintain analytical datasets, data marts, and reporting assets that support business intelligence and advanced analytics initiatives.
+ Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business questions into measurable analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
+ Apply AI-augmented analytics techniques to improve data exploration, pattern recognition, and insight generation while ensuring results are accurate, transparent, and business-relevant.
+ Develop reports, dashboards, visualizations, and presentations that communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
+ Implement data quality controls, validation routines, and reconciliation processes to maintain trusted analytical assets.
+ Document business rules, data lineage, analytical methodologies, and reporting logic to support governance and knowledge sharing.
+ Partner with data engineering teams to improve data availability, integration, performance, and analytic readiness.
+ Support ad hoc analytical requests related to portfolio performance, operational effectiveness, customer behavior, and business strategy.
+ Promote responsible, ethical, and compliant use of data and AI-assisted analytics technologies.
Work model
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants within the Eastern Time Zone (EST) . While Hartford, CT is the preferred location, qualified remote candidates located within EST will also be considered.
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
What you need to have to be considered
+ 6+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analysis, or related disciplines.
+ Strong expertise in Snowflake SQL, query optimization, and analytical data modeling.
+ Experience performing exploratory data analysis, trend analysis, statistical analysis, and business performance assessments.
+ Hands-on experience developing analytical datasets, reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
+ Experience working with structured and semi-structured data in cloud-based analytics environments.
+ Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, validation, and governance practices.
+ Experience collaborating with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven recommendations.
+ Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
+ Ability to work independently in a distributed team environment while managing multiple priorities.
These will help you stand out
+ Experience in the Property & Casualty Insurance industry.
+ Knowledge of underwriting, claims, policy administration, pricing, actuarial analysis, or insurance operations.
+ Experience with AI-assisted analytics, augmented analytics, or Generative AI-enabled analytical tools.
+ Familiarity with data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
+ Experience supporting regulatory reporting, operational performance measurement, and executive reporting initiatives.
+ Knowledge of cloud data platforms and modern analytics architectures.
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.
Compensation
Applications will be accepted until November 20, 2026.
The annual salary for this position is between $115,000- $135,000 , depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other factors permitted by applicable law.
This position is also eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable compensation plans.
Pay Transparency
The salary range provided reflects Cognizant's good-faith estimate of compensation for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation offered will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, technical expertise, certifications, education, internal equity, geographic location, and business needs.
Cognizant is committed to providing competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our associates.
Benefits
Subject to applicable eligibility requirements, Cognizant offers:
+ Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
+ Paid Holidays and Paid Time Off
+ 401(k) Plan with Company Contributions
+ Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Coverage
+ Paid Parental Leave
+ Employee Stock Purchase Plan
+ Employee Assistance and Wellbeing Programs
+ Training, Certification, and Professional Development Opportunities
Cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Fiscal Information and Data Analyst – Internal Only**

This is an internal opportunity and is only open to current HCA employees.

  

This position requires in-office attendance during the initial training period; following completion of training, employees are expected to work in-office every Tuesday and on an ad-hoc basis as business needs require.

  

All HCA employees are required to be Washington state residents upon their first day of employment.

**The Opportunity**

This position is responsible for developing and monitoring key components of the Medicaid services and benefits budget, the HCA’s administrative budget, agency budget requests, fiscal notes, and financial analyses in a manner that ensures the process undertaken and content of all deliverables meet the HCA and Office of Financial Management (OFM) requirements and guidelines. This position is responsible for identifying and analyzing financial variances and communicating them in an accurate, timely fashion to all parties as appropriate, to include program managers, HCA executive management, and OFM. Responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to, developing financial models, projections, and strategies to ensure sound financial management and operations of Medicaid programs and services. This work includes fiscal impact analysis and requires detailed knowledge and understanding of multiple program areas from the business, legislative, regulatory, budget, and technical perspectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform and provide complex analysis and financial modeling for Medicaid services related to and/or impacting Indian Health Services and Tribal providers under consideration by HCA’s Office of Tribal Affairs, the HCA Director, Chief Financial Officer, OFM, and Legislature that outline issues with current funding and/or initiate policy proposals to address anticipated future fiscal needs.
* Develop fiscal projections/impact analyses and related models in support of effective fiscal management of, and adequate funding for, agency programs; present analyses to HCA decision makers and other stakeholders; document development process, including assumptions, data sources, etc.
* Monitor and analyze agency expenditures impacting IHS/tribal provider services and MCO expenditures, including comparisons to relevant budgets, forecasts, and projections.
* Coordinate with fiscal and programmatic staff internal and external to the HCA to ensure 1) the accuracy of data and information presented in agency proposals and 2) that budget policy objectives are met while furthering the strategic goals of the HCA.
* Act as fiscal liaison and provide financial data and analysis to internal and external workgroups related to IHS/tribal providers.
* Contribute to the development of the Medicaid per capita forecast; confirm accuracy of forecast outputs related to IHS/ Tribal Provider services.
* Assist in the development of policy and rate setting related to tribal provider cost-based rates for residential treatment facilities and secure withdrawal management facilities.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**

Rather than just crunching numbers, the person in this position acts as a trusted strategic advisor and subject matter expert, navigating uncharted financial territory to build complex forecasting models and shape policy implementation. Crucially, the role offers the deeply rewarding purpose of safeguarding and optimizing healthcare funding for Indian Health Services and Tribal providers, ensuring that vulnerable populations receive essential medical, dental, and behavioral health services.

  

**What You Bring**

This position is an ideal career path for a high-level financial professional who thrives under high visibility, loves solving complex data puzzles, and wants their analytical skills to directly improve community health outcomes.

  

**Required Qualifications**

*Experience may have been gained through paid or unpaid activities. Please ensure any relevant experience defined below is outlined in your cover letter, resume, and application.*

**Comprehensive knowledge and thorough understanding of:**

* State and Federal Medicaid regulations and responsibilities.
* Budget development in private industry or at the federal, state or local level.
* General principles of health insurance structure, purchasing and employee benefits programs.

  

Policy development and implementation

* Ability to manage multiple high-priority assignments and resources concurrently, taking initiative to resolve problems or recommend alternative approaches when appropriate.
* Advanced level skills with Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of designing complex modeling, structuring ad-hoc data for use in pivot tables and composing nested formulas.

  
Advanced Financial Modeling & Predictive Analytics

* Complex Fiscal Modeling: Ability to design, build, and maintain sophisticated financial models.
* Forecasting & Trend Analysis: Experience contributing to complex financial models, tracking utilization, and recognizing long-term expenditure trends within data.

  

Strategic Advising & Policy Formulation

* Executive Briefing: Competency in translating data into clear policy briefings, white papers, and actionable strategies for executive leaders (ex. Director, CFO, and the Office of Tribal Affairs).

  

Program Oversight & Financial Governance

* Independent Expenditure Monitoring: Strong auditing capabilities to manage and oversee expenditure tracking, ensuring appropriate payment distribution.
* Reconciliation Leadership: Autonomy in tracking and executing complex financial reconciliations.
* Process Documentation: Hands on experience with a high attention to detail for documenting data sources, and underlying fiscal assumptions to ensure institutional knowledge retention.
* Ability to develop and review complex written materials and provide detailed policy analysis.

  

Stakeholder Collaboration & Intergovernmental Relations

* Interagency Representation: Ability to serve as the definitive subject matter expert on interagency policy and data workgroups.
* Cross-Sector Communication: High emotional intelligence and diplomacy required to act as a fiscal liaison among internal accounting/programmatic staff, federal partners, and external tribal leadership. Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to translate complex financial/analytical information for non-financial/analytical audiences.

  

**Required Competencies**

  

* **Equity lens** – All HCA employees are required to consider equity in their decisions, processes, and day-to-day work, including how their work may affect the people and communities we serve.
* **The ability to take action to learn and grow** – You take action to learn and grow by seeking new perspectives, learning from experiences, and using what you’ve learned to continuously improve how you work and serve others.
* **The ability to take action to meet the needs of others** – You take action to meet the needs of others by listening, understanding different perspectives, and responding with care, respect, and solutions that support the people of the communities we serve.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

*While these are not required, having them may help you stand out as an applicant.*

* Experience working with the Washington State Agency Financial Reporting System (AFRS) data.
* Experience contributing to decision packages and fiscal notes.
* Knowledge of protocols/processes of the executive/legislative branches of state government.
* Knowledge of the Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS).
* Experience with the Washington State Agency Budget System (ABS).
* Familiarity with State and Federal laws, rules, and regulations that impact/govern the State’s Medicaid, CHIP, and state funded health programs.
* Significant experience in working with large and complex budget development processes, significant experience and knowledge of the state budgetary process, including knowledge of Office of Financial Management and the State Legislative approach to the budget process.
* Experience querying data through programs such as SQL.
* Experience in the development of financial modeling.
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in statistics, science, mathematics, data science, public administration or related field.

OR

* Associate’s degree from an accredited college or university AND Five years of professional experience working with large, complex financial systems/information.

OR

* Seven years of professional experience working with large, complex financial systems/information.

**About the Financial Services Division (FSD)**

The Financial Services Division (FSD), in collaboration with other HCA divisions and a variety of external stakeholders and legislative partners, provides strategic financial expertise for Apple Health, Community Behavioral Health (CBH), PEBB and SEBB programs. In addition, FSD oversees the budget and compliance functions necessary to manage and monitor the single largest Washington State individual operating budget. Functions include budget management, accounting, forecasting, professional and hospital rate setting, financial analysis, and payment/collection operations. This division maintains a close working relationship with agency program, policy, and clinical divisions to ensure financially sound implementation and monitoring of program strategies.

**About the Washington State Health Care Authority**

*Better Health. Better Care. A Healthier Washington.*

At HCA, we work to ensure people across Washington have the opportunity to be as healthy as possible. As the State’s largest health care purchaser and behavioral health authority, HCA serves nearly 3 million Washington residents through Apple Health (Medicaid), Public Employees Benefits Board (PEBB) and School Employees Benefits Board (SEBB) programs, and behavioral health services. Through this work, HCA purchases and coordinates care coverage, supports behavioral health prevention, treatment, crisis response, and recovery and helps strengthen access to high-quality care across Washington.

**More than a benefits package:** We want our employees to have the support, flexibility, and benefits they need to do their best work and build a career that works for their life. As a Washington State HCA employee, you’ll have access to a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance. Our benefits are designed to support you today while helping you plan for the future. Learn more about why HCA by visiting the [Voices of HCA](https://connections.hca.wa.gov/columns/voices?title=&field_newsletter_issue_target_id=All&field_year_taxonomy_target_id=All&field_category_target_id=876) and the ["Who we are"](https://www.hca.wa.gov/about-hca/who-we-are) section of our website.

  

**Your total compensation is more than your paycheck:**

* Remote work and flexible schedules
* Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
* Paid vacation, sick leave, and 12 paid holidays
* Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML)
* Retirement options to plan for the future
* Training and professional development opportunities
* Employee wellness programs

**Work location and schedule:** This is a full-time 40-hour-per-week hybrid position. You will report to the HCA office located in Olympia, WA for in-person work. Our standard business hours are Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., with alternative work schedules considered based on business needs. When working in-person, you will work in a shared space, open office environment. In this role you’ll regularly collaborate with colleagues, agency leaders, state and federal partners, and other external partners or customers. Occasional travel may be required for meetings, training, or other business needs. All employees are required to report to our Olympia office on their first and final day of employment.

**Our commitment to an inclusive workplace:** The Health Care Authority is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a workplace where employees are respected, included, and supported in bringing their experiences, perspectives, and ideas to work. Our commitment to inclusion is reflected in how we work together and serve the people of Washington. HCA also supports five voluntary employee led Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which create opportunities for connection, community, learning, and professional growth.

**Application Directions**

To be considered, you must complete the online application in full and submit all required materials. Incomplete applications or applications missing required materials will not be considered. When completing your application, please include the following required materials:

* **Cover letter:** describing your qualifications for this specific position
* **Resume:** that details your applicable experience and education.
* **Three (3) professional references:** References must be entered directly into the designated references section of your application. We require 3 professional references including at least one current or recent supervisor.

**We encourage you to apply!** If you meet the required qualifications for this position; we want to hear from you. Desired qualifications describe additional experience, knowledge or skills that may be helpful in the role, but they are not required to be considered for the position. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences, identities, and perspectives.

**Veterans:** We value the experience and skill veterans bring to the workforce and encourage veterans, transitioning service members, and military spouses to apply. Eligible veterans may qualify for veterans’ preference in accordance with Washington State Law. If you are claiming veterans’ preference, you must attach your applicable **DD-214** documentation to your application. Please redact your social security number, date of birth, and any other sensitive information before uploading and attaching the document.

  

**Need accommodations or have questions?** If you have questions, need assistance with the application process, require an accommodation, or would like to request this posting in an alternative format, please contact the assigned recruiter, Angelic Matthews, at [HCAjobs@hca.wa.gov](mailto:HCAjobs@hca.wa.gov) and reference the recruitment title and job number in the subject line.

Senior Marketing Data Analyst (HP Solutions Marketing)

**Description -**

The Senior Marketing Data Analyst is a critical member of the Global HP Solutions Marketing team, responsible for turning complex marketing performance data into clear, actionable business insights.

This role will serve as a trusted analytics partner to marketing leaders and teams across HP Solutions. The analyst will develop a deep understanding of our marketing data, metrics, dashboards, and reporting flows; bring together information from multiple sources; identify performance drivers and data nuances; and translate findings into recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with business curiosity and clear communication. This person should be comfortable working with imperfect or fragmented data, investigating discrepancies, and partnering across teams to establish a reliable view of performance. Beyond reporting what happened, they will help explain why it happened, what it means, and what actions the team should take next.

  

**Responsibilities**

***Marketing Performance Analysis and Insights***

* Analyze marketing performance across audiences, campaigns, programs, markets, channels, and stages of the customer journey.

* Translate data into clear insights, implications, and recommendations for marketing leaders and business partners.

* Identify performance trends, drivers, gaps, and opportunities that inform marketing strategy, investment decisions, and execution.

* Develop executive-ready performance narratives that connect marketing activity to customer, commercial, and business outcomes.

* Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer priority business questions and support leadership decision-making.

* Move beyond descriptive reporting to diagnose performance and identify opportunities for optimization.

***Data and Dashboard Expertise***

* Develop a deep understanding of HP Solutions marketing data sources, dashboards, metrics, definitions, and reporting processes.

* Pull, combine, validate, and interpret data from multiple dashboards, platforms, and business sources.

* Understand how data flows across systems and identify dependencies, limitations, and potential sources of inconsistency.

* Investigate data discrepancies and partner with relevant teams to resolve issues or clearly communicate limitations.

* Ensure analyses use appropriate definitions, methodologies, comparison periods, and levels of granularity.

* Help stakeholders navigate available dashboards and understand what the data can and cannot reliably indicate.

***Measurement and Reporting***

* Support recurring marketing performance reporting, leadership reviews, quarterly business reviews, and planning processes.

* Track relevant metrics across the marketing funnel, including audience engagement, demand generation, conversion, pipeline, revenue influence, and marketing efficiency.

* Help define appropriate KPIs and measurement approaches based on business objectives and available data.

* Improve the consistency, accuracy, and usability of marketing performance reporting.

* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, or enhance recurring analysis and reporting.

* Partner with measurement, operations, finance, and business teams to connect marketing indicators with broader commercial performance.

***Business Partnership***

* Serve as a trusted thought partner to HP Solutions marketing leaders, planners, campaign teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders.

* Work with stakeholders to translate business questions into structured analytical approaches.

* Proactively identify questions and insights that may not be visible through standard reporting.

* Challenge assumptions constructively and use data to bring objectivity to business discussions.

* Communicate complex findings in a concise, practical, and audience-appropriate way.

* Build strong relationships across global and market teams to improve data understanding, adoption, and decision-making.

***Data Quality and Continuous Improvement***

* Identify gaps in data availability, quality, definitions, and reporting processes.

* Document key metrics, data sources, methodologies, assumptions, and known limitations.

* Partner with data owners and technical teams to improve data reliability and reporting capabilities.

* Promote consistent use of marketing metrics and definitions across the organization.

* Recommend enhancements to dashboards, reporting workflows, and analytical processes based on stakeholder needs.

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in business analytics, marketing, economics, statistics, engineering, finance, or a related field.

* Typically 10+ years of experience in data analytics, marketing analytics, business intelligence, commercial analytics, or a related field.

* Demonstrated experience analyzing marketing or commercial performance data and translating findings into business recommendations.

* Experience working with multiple data sources, dashboards, and reporting environments.

* Strong proficiency in Excel and data visualization or business intelligence tools, such as Power BI or equivalent platforms.

* Ability to validate data, reconcile discrepancies, and understand the relationships between different metrics and systems.

* Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous questions and develop practical analytical approaches.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create concise, executive-ready insights and presentations.

* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across functions and within a complex, global, or matrixed organization.

* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the broader business question.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B, technology, SaaS, services, or solutions marketing.

* Familiarity with marketing funnel, campaign, demand generation, pipeline, revenue influence, ROI, and incrementality measurement.

* Experience with SQL, Python, or other analytical tools used to extract, transform, or analyze data.

* Experience working with CRM, marketing automation, digital analytics, financial, or customer data.

* Understanding of data visualization and dashboard design principles.

* Experience identifying opportunities to automate or streamline recurring reporting.

* Advanced degree or relevant analytics certification is helpful but not required.

  

**Key Competencies**

* Analytical rigor and intellectual curiosity

* Business and marketing acumen

* Insight generation and storytelling

* Data fluency and attention to detail

* Structured problem-solving

* Executive communication

* Cross-functional collaboration

* Comfort with ambiguity

* Proactive ownership and accountability

* Continuous improvement mindset

  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Marketing leaders have a clearer, more reliable view of HP Solutions marketing performance.

* Data from multiple sources is translated into a coherent performance narrative rather than presented as disconnected metrics.

* Leadership discussions move more quickly from reporting results to understanding implications and taking action.

* Data nuances, limitations, and inconsistencies are surfaced and addressed proactively.

* Marketing teams increasingly use data to shape priorities, optimize execution, and make investment decisions.

* Recurring reporting becomes more accurate, efficient, and decision-oriented.

  

**Salary**

The pay range for this role is **$130,700** to **$205,200** USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.  
  
**Benefits:**  
HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:  

* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Long term/short term disability insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Life insurance
* Generous time off policies, including;
* 4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure
* 11 paid holidays
* Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave ([US benefits overview](https://hpbenefits.ce.alight.com/))

  
The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

  

**Disclaimer**

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Every prescription CenterWell Pharmacy fills depends on a chain of people being in the right place at the right time. The Workforce Planning team makes sure that capacity exists before the demand arrives. The team conducts long-term forecasts that impact hiring, mid-term capacity plans that shape staffing strategy, and short-term plans that hold service levels week to week.
If you have done demand planning or S&OP for a physical supply chain, this is the same discipline — our constrained resource is licensed, trained people instead of inventory.
We are building this function from the ground up. The architecture, the metrics, and the tooling are not decided yet, and we are hiring two Senior Data Analysts to help decide them.

+ Turn messy, multi-source operational data into planning inputs the business can act on
+ Partner with operations, finance, and department leaders to understand what they actually need to decide
+ Build the tooling and data products that let planners and leaders answer their own questions
+ Bring rigor to how we measure ourselves — forecast accuracy, capacity use, cost per prescription, and the drivers underneath them

Focus Area 1 — Data Engineering & Architecture
You would own how planning data reaches the people who use it — the pipelines that consolidate workforce, volume, and operational data across platforms, and the models our forecasting tools run on. You have built ETL/ELT pipelines in a cloud data environment (Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar), work fluently in Python, and know dimensional modeling and data warehouse design.

You would own how planning insight turns into decisions — the dashboards and self-service tools operations leaders run their business on, and the KPI definitions underneath them. You have advanced Power BI skills (or Tableau/Looker and willingness to switch), have built KPI frameworks from scratch, and can decompose a metric to root cause rather than reporting variance.

**Description -**

The Senior Marketing Data Analyst is a critical member of the Global HP Solutions Marketing team, responsible for turning complex marketing performance data into clear, actionable business insights.

This role will serve as a trusted analytics partner to marketing leaders and teams across HP Solutions. The analyst will develop a deep understanding of our marketing data, metrics, dashboards, and reporting flows; bring together information from multiple sources; identify performance drivers and data nuances; and translate findings into recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with business curiosity and clear communication. This person should be comfortable working with imperfect or fragmented data, investigating discrepancies, and partnering across teams to establish a reliable view of performance. Beyond reporting what happened, they will help explain why it happened, what it means, and what actions the team should take next.

  

**Responsibilities**

***Marketing Performance Analysis and Insights***

* Analyze marketing performance across audiences, campaigns, programs, markets, channels, and stages of the customer journey.

* Translate data into clear insights, implications, and recommendations for marketing leaders and business partners.

* Identify performance trends, drivers, gaps, and opportunities that inform marketing strategy, investment decisions, and execution.

* Develop executive-ready performance narratives that connect marketing activity to customer, commercial, and business outcomes.

* Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer priority business questions and support leadership decision-making.

* Move beyond descriptive reporting to diagnose performance and identify opportunities for optimization.

***Data and Dashboard Expertise***

* Develop a deep understanding of HP Solutions marketing data sources, dashboards, metrics, definitions, and reporting processes.

* Pull, combine, validate, and interpret data from multiple dashboards, platforms, and business sources.

* Understand how data flows across systems and identify dependencies, limitations, and potential sources of inconsistency.

* Investigate data discrepancies and partner with relevant teams to resolve issues or clearly communicate limitations.

* Ensure analyses use appropriate definitions, methodologies, comparison periods, and levels of granularity.

* Help stakeholders navigate available dashboards and understand what the data can and cannot reliably indicate.

***Measurement and Reporting***

* Support recurring marketing performance reporting, leadership reviews, quarterly business reviews, and planning processes.

* Track relevant metrics across the marketing funnel, including audience engagement, demand generation, conversion, pipeline, revenue influence, and marketing efficiency.

* Help define appropriate KPIs and measurement approaches based on business objectives and available data.

* Improve the consistency, accuracy, and usability of marketing performance reporting.

* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, or enhance recurring analysis and reporting.

* Partner with measurement, operations, finance, and business teams to connect marketing indicators with broader commercial performance.

***Business Partnership***

* Serve as a trusted thought partner to HP Solutions marketing leaders, planners, campaign teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders.

* Work with stakeholders to translate business questions into structured analytical approaches.

* Proactively identify questions and insights that may not be visible through standard reporting.

* Challenge assumptions constructively and use data to bring objectivity to business discussions.

* Communicate complex findings in a concise, practical, and audience-appropriate way.

* Build strong relationships across global and market teams to improve data understanding, adoption, and decision-making.

***Data Quality and Continuous Improvement***

* Identify gaps in data availability, quality, definitions, and reporting processes.

* Document key metrics, data sources, methodologies, assumptions, and known limitations.

* Partner with data owners and technical teams to improve data reliability and reporting capabilities.

* Promote consistent use of marketing metrics and definitions across the organization.

* Recommend enhancements to dashboards, reporting workflows, and analytical processes based on stakeholder needs.

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Experience working with multiple data sources, dashboards, and reporting environments.

* Strong proficiency in Excel and data visualization or business intelligence tools, such as Power BI or equivalent platforms.

* Ability to validate data, reconcile discrepancies, and understand the relationships between different metrics and systems.

* Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous questions and develop practical analytical approaches.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create concise, executive-ready insights and presentations.

* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across functions and within a complex, global, or matrixed organization.

* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the broader business question.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B, technology, SaaS, services, or solutions marketing.

* Familiarity with marketing funnel, campaign, demand generation, pipeline, revenue influence, ROI, and incrementality measurement.

* Experience with SQL, Python, or other analytical tools used to extract, transform, or analyze data.

* Understanding of data visualization and dashboard design principles.

* Experience identifying opportunities to automate or streamline recurring reporting.

**Key Competencies**

* Insight generation and storytelling

* Data fluency and attention to detail

* Leadership discussions move more quickly from reporting results to understanding implications and taking action.

* Data nuances, limitations, and inconsistencies are surfaced and addressed proactively.

**Fiscal Information and Data Analyst – Internal Only**

This is an internal opportunity and is only open to current HCA employees.

  

This position requires in-office attendance during the initial training period; following completion of training, employees are expected to work in-office every Tuesday and on an ad-hoc basis as business needs require.

  

All HCA employees are required to be Washington state residents upon their first day of employment.

**The Opportunity**

This position is responsible for developing and monitoring key components of the Medicaid services and benefits budget, the HCA’s administrative budget, agency budget requests, fiscal notes, and financial analyses in a manner that ensures the process undertaken and content of all deliverables meet the HCA and Office of Financial Management (OFM) requirements and guidelines. This position is responsible for identifying and analyzing financial variances and communicating them in an accurate, timely fashion to all parties as appropriate, to include program managers, HCA executive management, and OFM. Responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to, developing financial models, projections, and strategies to ensure sound financial management and operations of Medicaid programs and services. This work includes fiscal impact analysis and requires detailed knowledge and understanding of multiple program areas from the business, legislative, regulatory, budget, and technical perspectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform and provide complex analysis and financial modeling for Medicaid services related to and/or impacting Indian Health Services and Tribal providers under consideration by HCA’s Office of Tribal Affairs, the HCA Director, Chief Financial Officer, OFM, and Legislature that outline issues with current funding and/or initiate policy proposals to address anticipated future fiscal needs.
* Develop fiscal projections/impact analyses and related models in support of effective fiscal management of, and adequate funding for, agency programs; present analyses to HCA decision makers and other stakeholders; document development process, including assumptions, data sources, etc.
* Monitor and analyze agency expenditures impacting IHS/tribal provider services and MCO expenditures, including comparisons to relevant budgets, forecasts, and projections.
* Coordinate with fiscal and programmatic staff internal and external to the HCA to ensure 1) the accuracy of data and information presented in agency proposals and 2) that budget policy objectives are met while furthering the strategic goals of the HCA.
* Act as fiscal liaison and provide financial data and analysis to internal and external workgroups related to IHS/tribal providers.
* Contribute to the development of the Medicaid per capita forecast; confirm accuracy of forecast outputs related to IHS/ Tribal Provider services.
* Assist in the development of policy and rate setting related to tribal provider cost-based rates for residential treatment facilities and secure withdrawal management facilities.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**

Rather than just crunching numbers, the person in this position acts as a trusted strategic advisor and subject matter expert, navigating uncharted financial territory to build complex forecasting models and shape policy implementation. Crucially, the role offers the deeply rewarding purpose of safeguarding and optimizing healthcare funding for Indian Health Services and Tribal providers, ensuring that vulnerable populations receive essential medical, dental, and behavioral health services.

  

**What You Bring**

This position is an ideal career path for a high-level financial professional who thrives under high visibility, loves solving complex data puzzles, and wants their analytical skills to directly improve community health outcomes.

  

**Required Qualifications**

*Experience may have been gained through paid or unpaid activities. Please ensure any relevant experience defined below is outlined in your cover letter, resume, and application.*

**Comprehensive knowledge and thorough understanding of:**

* State and Federal Medicaid regulations and responsibilities.
* Budget development in private industry or at the federal, state or local level.
* General principles of health insurance structure, purchasing and employee benefits programs.

  

Policy development and implementation

* Ability to manage multiple high-priority assignments and resources concurrently, taking initiative to resolve problems or recommend alternative approaches when appropriate.
* Advanced level skills with Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of designing complex modeling, structuring ad-hoc data for use in pivot tables and composing nested formulas.

  
Advanced Financial Modeling & Predictive Analytics

* Complex Fiscal Modeling: Ability to design, build, and maintain sophisticated financial models.
* Forecasting & Trend Analysis: Experience contributing to complex financial models, tracking utilization, and recognizing long-term expenditure trends within data.

  

Strategic Advising & Policy Formulation

* Executive Briefing: Competency in translating data into clear policy briefings, white papers, and actionable strategies for executive leaders (ex. Director, CFO, and the Office of Tribal Affairs).

  

Program Oversight & Financial Governance

* Independent Expenditure Monitoring: Strong auditing capabilities to manage and oversee expenditure tracking, ensuring appropriate payment distribution.
* Reconciliation Leadership: Autonomy in tracking and executing complex financial reconciliations.
* Process Documentation: Hands on experience with a high attention to detail for documenting data sources, and underlying fiscal assumptions to ensure institutional knowledge retention.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Intergovernmental Relations

Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to translate complex financial/analytical information for non-financial/analytical audiences.

**Description -**

The Senior Marketing Data Analyst is a critical member of the Global HP Solutions Marketing team, responsible for turning complex marketing performance data into clear, actionable business insights.

This role will serve as a trusted analytics partner to marketing leaders and teams across HP Solutions. The analyst will develop a deep understanding of our marketing data, metrics, dashboards, and reporting flows; bring together information from multiple sources; identify performance drivers and data nuances; and translate findings into recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with business curiosity and clear communication. This person should be comfortable working with imperfect or fragmented data, investigating discrepancies, and partnering across teams to establish a reliable view of performance. Beyond reporting what happened, they will help explain why it happened, what it means, and what actions the team should take next.

  

**Responsibilities**

***Marketing Performance Analysis and Insights***

* Analyze marketing performance across audiences, campaigns, programs, markets, channels, and stages of the customer journey.

* Translate data into clear insights, implications, and recommendations for marketing leaders and business partners.

* Identify performance trends, drivers, gaps, and opportunities that inform marketing strategy, investment decisions, and execution.

* Develop executive-ready performance narratives that connect marketing activity to customer, commercial, and business outcomes.

* Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer priority business questions and support leadership decision-making.

* Move beyond descriptive reporting to diagnose performance and identify opportunities for optimization.

***Data and Dashboard Expertise***

* Develop a deep understanding of HP Solutions marketing data sources, dashboards, metrics, definitions, and reporting processes.

* Pull, combine, validate, and interpret data from multiple dashboards, platforms, and business sources.

* Understand how data flows across systems and identify dependencies, limitations, and potential sources of inconsistency.

* Investigate data discrepancies and partner with relevant teams to resolve issues or clearly communicate limitations.

* Ensure analyses use appropriate definitions, methodologies, comparison periods, and levels of granularity.

* Help stakeholders navigate available dashboards and understand what the data can and cannot reliably indicate.

***Measurement and Reporting***

* Support recurring marketing performance reporting, leadership reviews, quarterly business reviews, and planning processes.

* Track relevant metrics across the marketing funnel, including audience engagement, demand generation, conversion, pipeline, revenue influence, and marketing efficiency.

* Help define appropriate KPIs and measurement approaches based on business objectives and available data.

* Improve the consistency, accuracy, and usability of marketing performance reporting.

* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, or enhance recurring analysis and reporting.

* Partner with measurement, operations, finance, and business teams to connect marketing indicators with broader commercial performance.

***Business Partnership***

* Serve as a trusted thought partner to HP Solutions marketing leaders, planners, campaign teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders.

* Work with stakeholders to translate business questions into structured analytical approaches.

* Proactively identify questions and insights that may not be visible through standard reporting.

* Challenge assumptions constructively and use data to bring objectivity to business discussions.

* Communicate complex findings in a concise, practical, and audience-appropriate way.

* Build strong relationships across global and market teams to improve data understanding, adoption, and decision-making.

***Data Quality and Continuous Improvement***

* Identify gaps in data availability, quality, definitions, and reporting processes.

* Document key metrics, data sources, methodologies, assumptions, and known limitations.

* Partner with data owners and technical teams to improve data reliability and reporting capabilities.

* Promote consistent use of marketing metrics and definitions across the organization.

* Recommend enhancements to dashboards, reporting workflows, and analytical processes based on stakeholder needs.

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in business analytics, marketing, economics, statistics, engineering, finance, or a related field.

* Typically 10+ years of experience in data analytics, marketing analytics, business intelligence, commercial analytics, or a related field.

* Demonstrated experience analyzing marketing or commercial performance data and translating findings into business recommendations.

* Experience working with multiple data sources, dashboards, and reporting environments.

* Strong proficiency in Excel and data visualization or business intelligence tools, such as Power BI or equivalent platforms.

* Ability to validate data, reconcile discrepancies, and understand the relationships between different metrics and systems.

* Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous questions and develop practical analytical approaches.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create concise, executive-ready insights and presentations.

* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across functions and within a complex, global, or matrixed organization.

* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the broader business question.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B, technology, SaaS, services, or solutions marketing.

* Familiarity with marketing funnel, campaign, demand generation, pipeline, revenue influence, ROI, and incrementality measurement.

* Experience with SQL, Python, or other analytical tools used to extract, transform, or analyze data.

* Experience working with CRM, marketing automation, digital analytics, financial, or customer data.

* Understanding of data visualization and dashboard design principles.

* Experience identifying opportunities to automate or streamline recurring reporting.

* Advanced degree or relevant analytics certification is helpful but not required.

* Analytical rigor and intellectual curiosity

* Business and marketing acumen

* Insight generation and storytelling

* Data fluency and attention to detail

* Structured problem-solving

* Executive communication

* Cross-functional collaboration

* Comfort with ambiguity

* Proactive ownership and accountability

* Continuous improvement mindset

* Marketing leaders have a clearer, more reliable view of HP Solutions marketing performance.

* Data from multiple sources is translated into a coherent performance narrative rather than presented as disconnected metrics.

* Leadership discussions move more quickly from reporting results to understanding implications and taking action.

* Data nuances, limitations, and inconsistencies are surfaced and addressed proactively.

* Marketing teams increasingly use data to shape priorities, optimize execution, and make investment decisions.

* Recurring reporting becomes more accurate, efficient, and decision-oriented.
